LIVE CONNECTION

Connect to the student app’s Supabase project

The student app’s project URL and publishable key are prefilled. Existing student and admin Auth accounts work here without being copied. These are client-side values; never enter a service-role secret. For live Supabase mode, serve this file from an http(s) site; some browsers block API requests from file:// URLs.

Database setup SQL (copy into Supabase SQL Editor)

The full setup includes the shared P4-to-P7 sequence and admin set-assignment feature. If the setup has already succeeded, do not rerun it for this feature; use the separate existing-install update below. Then run admin authorization if needed, review the profile-security patch, and run the read-only verifier. The browser cannot safely execute schema changes; use the existing student app project’s SQL Editor.

Admin set assignment update SQL (for existing setup)

This idempotent migration updates existing installs so new sets draw the next unused Science questions in one shared order: P4, P5, P6, then P7. A new student therefore starts at P4 question 1; existing assignments and active sets are preserved. It also lets admins repeat a completed set or assign the next unused questions. It does not change Auth or profile rows. A paused student needs a positive target before receiving another set.

Auth uses the existing SmartPle project; Q-A profile/class data is synchronized from smartple_profiles. Admin access also requires the owner-managed daily_qa_admins allowlist.
